product_overview: ClaudiaShop is an e-commerce web app for browsing and purchasing digital image packs. Buyers can review packs, complete payments via MercadoPago or PayPal, and receive time-limited download links; admins can manage packs and view sales.
core_goals: Browse and discover available image packs and their details
Add packs to a cart and complete purchases using MercadoPago or PayPal
Receive secure, time-limited download links after successful purchase
Allow admins to create and manage packs (title, price, images, zip) from an authenticated dashboard
Allow admins to review sales history with pagination and basic search

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Landing page that presents a hero section and a preview of available packs to start discovery.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View hero section on page load -> View list of available packs
Navigate to / -> View hero section on page load -> Navigate to /packs -> View all packs

features.name: Pack Details (Browse and Add to Cart)
features.description: View a pack's full information and images from the pack listing and add the pack to the shopping cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /packs -> View list of packs -> Select a pack from the listing to view its details -> View pack information and images -> Add pack to cart -> Open cart drawer
Navigate to /packs -> View list of packs -> Add a pack to cart directly from the listing -> Open cart drawer -> Review cart items

features.name: Cart and Checkout
features.description: Review items in the cart, choose a payment provider (MercadoPago or PayPal), and complete the purchase to receive download access.
user_flows: Open cart drawer -> Review cart items -> Navigate to /checkout -> Select payment method (MercadoPago or PayPal) -> Click pay to initiate payment -> Return to /success after approval -> See success page with download tokens
Open cart drawer -> Review cart items -> Navigate to /checkout -> Select MercadoPago as payment method -> Click pay to initiate MercadoPago flow -> Return to /success and view download tokens

features.name: Post-purchase Success and Downloads
features.description: Show purchase confirmation with the generated, time-limited download links and allow users to download purchased ZIP files.
user_flows: Complete payment and arrive at /success -> See success message and list of download links with expiry information -> Click a download link -> Initiate token-based download for the purchased pack

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Authenticate as an admin to access protected admin pages and management features.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Fill email -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View sidebar navigation
Navigate to /admin -> Leave password empty -> Submit login form -> See validation error for required password

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated admin landing area with sidebar navigation to create packs and view sales.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View sidebar navigation -> Navigate to /admin/create-pack -> Return to /admin/dashboard -> Navigate to /admin/sales -> View sales table
Navigate to /admin/dashboard -> View sidebar navigation -> Logout -> Navigate to /admin

features.name: Create Pack
features.description: Admin form to create a new image pack with metadata, pricing, images and ZIP upload.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/create-pack -> Fill pack name -> Set price -> Upload images -> Add items -> Submit create pack form -> See confirmation of created pack
Navigate to /admin/create-pack -> Leave pack name empty -> Submit create pack form -> See validation error for required name

features.name: Sales Admin
features.description: View and search recorded sales with pagination to review orders and revenue at a glance.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/sales -> View sales table -> Navigate pages to see older records -> Use search to filter sales by term -> Open sale details from the list
Navigate to /admin/sales -> View sales table -> Use search with no results -> See empty state indicating no matching sales
